recent_reviews.title: They we very good in accommodating me…
product doesn’t work
recent_reviews.body: I’m updating my previous review because while customer support is responsive, the answers I'm receiving make absolutely no logical sense. The product itself is incredibly expensive and has had zero effect. To make matters worse, I am locked into a 3-month subscription for something that simply does not perform as advertised. When I reached out about this, customer support told me that the first bottle I received was supposed to last 90 days. However, the bottle ran out in less than 30 days. Here is the baffling part: the company automatically sent me a second bottle within a month of receiving my first one. If the first bottle was truly meant to last 90 days, why did their own automated system ship a replacement after only 30? They are changing their narrative to avoid accountability. Responsive customer service means nothing if they are feeding you false information to justify a bad product and a predatory subscription model.
